from collections import deque

def admit(requests, capacity, refill_every, window, window_max):
    results = []
    client_state = {}  # client -> [tokens, last_update_time]
    admitted_times = deque()  # times of admitted requests, in order

    for (t, client, cost) in requests:
        # get or init client state
        if client not in client_state:
            client_state[client] = [capacity, 0]
        state = client_state[client]
        tokens, last_time = state

        # apply refills from last_time to t
        if refill_every > 0:
            refills = t // refill_every - last_time // refill_every
            if refills > 0:
                tokens = min(capacity, tokens + refills)
        # update last_time regardless
        last_time = t
        state[0] = tokens
        state[1] = last_time

        # remove old entries from admitted_times that are no longer in window
        while admitted_times and admitted_times[0] <= t - window:
            admitted_times.popleft()

        window_count = len(admitted_times)

        if tokens >= cost and window_count < window_max:
            # admit
            tokens -= cost
            state[0] = tokens
            admitted_times.append(t)
            results.append(True)
        else:
            results.append(False)

    return results
